chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the refrain 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to humans and jinn, highlighting the continuous and abundant nature of divine favors (ni'mah) that serve as proof for resurrection and accountability. The rhetorical question underscores the inevitability of gratitude, linking the recognition of blessings directly to the acknowledgment of Allah's sovereignty and the Day of Judgment.
